Kevin (Presales): They want 99.9% text <350ms, chat <900ms. Prefer Private but can accept limited cross-AZ for non-sensitive bursts if approved.
Irene Ops: Quick rec: reserve 3x A100-equiv (quantized) to cover steady + cushion. Autoscale: add 1 GPU at gpu_util>65% for 3m, add 2 if >80% for 2m. Burst credits cap 40% reserved for 30m.
Ana S.: What about KV warm? 
Irene Ops: Preheat snippet: for i in 1..120 post /chat with short seed to warm KV across sessions. Include in launch checklist.
Kevin (Presales): Billing Q: can we give a monthly overage cap? Finance asked for predictability.
BillingBot: Yes—offer reserved baseline + optional capped overage (surcharge applies). We'll include alerts at 70% of cap.
Ana S.: Action items: Kevin to confirm cap preference, Irene to write preheat runbook and autoscale JSON, BillingBot to add cap pricing. ETA EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:
